persona_summary: CS Junior, no minor, 36 courses, Good standing
question: I need to take 15-214 for my CS degree. It's a required course, right? When is it offered at CMU-Q?
false_assumption_or_hidden_conflict: 15-214 (Principles of Software Construction) may not be offered at CMU-Q — it could be a Pittsburgh campus course. Or the course code may be slightly wrong. The student assumes it's both required and available at their campus.
naive_system_response: A naive system either fabricates a schedule for 15-214 or says 'let me look that up' and returns catalog data without noting the campus distinction, leading the student to believe they can take it at CMU-Q.
correct_response: 15-214 [does not appear in the CMU-Q course catalog / is a Pittsburgh campus course not offered at CMU-Q]. For your CS degree at CMU-Q, the equivalent requirement is satisfied by [correct course code and name]. This course is offered in [semester] at [time]. Would you like me to add it to your plan?
why_multi_agent_helps: The Courses Agent checks the CMU-Q specific catalog and would flag that 15-214 doesn't exist at CMU-Q. A single agent might search the broader CMU catalog and return Pittsburgh campus information as if it applies locally.
key_facts: Not all CMU Pittsburgh courses are offered at CMU-Q
Course codes may be similar but campus availability differs
The correct response identifies the right CMU-Q equivalent
known_traps: Accepting the course code and fabricating availability information
Not distinguishing CMU-Q catalog from Pittsburgh catalog
Confirming a course is 'required' without checking CMU-Q specific requirements
advisor_validation_needed: Verify: (1) whether 15-214 exists at CMU-Q, (2) the correct CMU-Q equivalent, (3) CMU-Q CS degree requirements list
